text:
On a cold day, a shiny metal rod feels colder to the touch than a black plastic rod.
Which statement explains this observation?
A
The metal rod is a better absorber of infra-red radiation than the plastic rod.
B
The metal rod is a better thermal conductor than the plastic rod.
C
The metal rod is a worse absorber of infra-red radiation than the plastic rod.
D
The metal rod is a worse thermal conductor than the plastic rod.

options.label: A
options.text: The metal rod is a better absorber of infra-red radiation than the plastic rod.

options.label: B
options.text: The metal rod is a better thermal conductor than the plastic rod.

options.label: C
options.text: The metal rod is a worse absorber of infra-red radiation than the plastic rod.

options.label: D
options.text: The metal rod is a worse thermal conductor than the plastic rod.
